title: A top copper layer with file attributes (Gerber X2)
how: Drawn in the file: after D10 a move to (2, 3) and two straight lines (to (8, 3) and to (8, 7)) = 2 lines; flashes: D11 at two points and D12 at one = 3 flashes;
5 objects in all, 3 apertures (D10, D11, D12), units mm, closed by M02.
The file function says Copper, L1, Top, so the layer is told by its attributes and no note about the role is made; the only set of object attributes is the empty one.
